instruction: My spotify premium membership just expired yesterday. Renew it for the same duration.
notes: Single-app task (spotify). The expired subscription's duration is unknown initially, so it is modeled as an abstract duration object linked by the static fact (expired-subscription-duration ...) and discovered via spotify.show_premium_subscriptions (effect found-duration). A payment card id is discovered via spotify.show_payment_cards (known-id). spotify.subscribe_premium requires both and may only be invoked with the same duration as the expired subscription; its effect (premium-renewed) is the sole task-specific goal condition and the precondition of supervisor.complete_task, which is called without an answer. Side-effect records (receipt email/file) created by subscribing are not modeled. Reference solution may additionally call spotify.show_premium_plans, which is informational only and omitted.
